_meta.notes: Append-only iteration log. Read at run start; never written at runtime. New entries appended manually or proposed by scripts/diff_against_template.py with status='proposed' awaiting human sign-off. ID format YYYY-MM-DD-NNN (zero-padded daily counter). Categories: rendering / content / branding / logic / data / ux / schema / infra. Severities: low / medium / high / critical. Statuses: open / in-progress / resolved / wontfix / proposed.

entries.title: provenance.data_source enum did not include keywords_everywhere_gkp
entries.detail: Whalen wrongful-death run resolved 100% of volume via Keywords Everywhere (GKP). The per-row keywords[].data_source enum includes 'keywords_everywhere_gkp' (aligned 2026-06-08) but the provenance.data_source summary enum only had ahrefs/content_gap/llm_estimate/mixed, so a fully-KE run could not validate without mislabeling its source. Fixed by adding 'keywords_everywhere_gkp' to the provenance enum (schema v1.0.2). Any run whose volume is entirely KE now validates truthfully.
